title: Echo2Pheno neural network finds cardiac phenotypes in conscious knockout mice
summary: Echo2Pheno combines a neural network for echocardiographic image analysis with statistical hypothesis testing on 2,159 images from 16 knockout mouse strains of the German Mouse Clinic. It confirmed a known Dystrophin phenotype and identified novel cardiovascular phenotypes for Cnot6l and Sytl4, which were verified with H&E-stained histological images. It covers few strains and the histology details were not reviewed; this is a version 1 preprint abstract.
ai_technology: Neural network module for echocardiographic image analysis and phenotypic measurement in conscious mice, plus a statistical testing framework

evidence.tested: Histological confirmation of the novel phenotypes in H&E-stained images, and recovery of a known Dystrophin phenotype.
evidence.unknown: Number of animals per strain, histology scope and generality beyond these strains; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Measures cardiac phenotypes automatically and flags genotype-phenotype differences.

source_review.scope: Version 1 abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; author affiliations from Europe PMC or Crossref. Full text not accessed.
